page.overview:
Who is Cassie?

This article is about a minor character from Mortal Kombat: Conquest. For other character with the name Cassie, see Cassie (disambiguation).

Cassie was a minor character who appeared in Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Quan Chi”. She was portrayed by Beth McKenzie.

Cassie was a flower girl on Zhu Zin. One night Taja want to buy some flowers, but unfortunately Cassie had already sold all of them. Then she told Taja visit her in the morning, because she was getting a bunch of roses. Next morning Taja didn't see Cassie, only a new girl, Siann, who told her that Cassie is sick. Later an old woman found Cassie's dead body, who was murdered by Siann, whose true identity is one of Quan Chi's servants.
